clue.text: It gauges the depth of colour, initially multiplied by ten

annotationWithheld.clue: It gauges the depth of colour, initially multiplied by ten

clue.text: One demonstrating for Johnson the triumph of hope over experience

definitions.text: One demonstrating for Johnson the triumph of hope over experience

parts.words: One demonstrating for Johnson the triumph of hope over experience
parts.note: Samuel Johnson called a second marriage the triumph of hope over experience, so the clue describes someone who weds a second time

explanation.surface: A person who shows what Dr Johnson meant by his famous remark.
explanation.walkthrough: Johnson made the remark about a man who remarried after an unhappy first marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A digamist is someone who marries a second time after the first marriage ends.

clue.text: A sailor's dance

definitions.meaning: John ..., the Scottish-born American naval commander, often known by his last two names
a ballroom mixer dance in which partners change when the music stops

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a famous naval hero and to a party mixer in which partners swap.

clue.text: Dynasty founded originally by treacherously usurping dominion of Richard

indicators.note: originally says take the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: How a royal house came to power by seizing the throne of Richard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes the first letters of 'treacherously usurping dominion of Richard'. Henry Tudor took the English crown from Richard III at Bosworth in 1485.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the English royal house from Henry VII to Elizabeth I.

clue.text: Crush a nut noisily

indicators.note: noisily says we want a word that sounds the same as the nut

parts.note: a conker is the shiny nut of the horse chestnut tree

explanation.surface: Instructions to smash a nut loudly.
explanation.walkthrough: CONKERS are horse-chestnut seeds that British children thread on strings for a game of smashing each other's.
explanation.definitionFit: To crush an opponent is to defeat them completely.

clue.text: Stout fellow employed in a hospital

definitions.meaning: stout is a dark beer, and the dark beer once drunk by London market workers bears the same name
a hospital worker who wheels patients and moves equipment between wards

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one word: a dark brewed ale, and the attendant who moves patients around a hospital.

clue.text: Nothing and nobody broadcast without help

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
none means not one person
broadcast means scattered, as seed is sown

explanation.surface: Nothing and nobody were on the air, without assistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' is the farming sense: seed scattered by hand, so SOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something by oneself, independently, with no one assisting.

clue.text: Hair of girl set about right

indicators.note: about says the girl's name goes round the other letter

parts.note: Tess is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl's hair is set and styled properly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts TESS round R; 'set' only links the parts.
explanation.definitionFit: A tress is a long lock of a woman's hair.

clue.text: One who behaves badly when mother's out of town

indicators.note: out of says the word for mother is removed from the town

parts.note: Rotterdam is a Dutch port city
a dam is an animal's mother

explanation.surface: A child who misbehaves whenever mum leaves town.
explanation.walkthrough: DAM, a mother of animals, is taken 'out of' ROTTERDAM.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotter is a dated British term for a cad or scoundrel.

clue.text: Sample worth a second look

parts.note: to watch is to look at

explanation.surface: A specimen deserving another glance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worth a' only links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A swatch is a small piece of fabric given as a specimen of the cloth.

clue.text: Oxygenated medicine put back in bottle

indicators.note: in here places the oxygen symbol inside the turned medicine
put back says the medicine word is read in the backward direction

parts.note: a drug is a medicine
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen, so something oxygenated has an O added

explanation.surface: A patient's oxygenated medicine is returned to its bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' turns DRUG into GURD, and the O (oxygen) goes into it after the G. 'Bottle' is the definition at the far end.
explanation.definitionFit: A dried hollow gourd has long served as a water flask or container.

clue.text: Wood of western variety

indicators.note: a variety of the letters is a fresh arrangement of the two words before it

explanation.surface: A forest whose trees are of a kind typical of the American West.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' rearranges the nine letters of OF WESTERN. THE NEW FOREST is an ancient royal woodland in Hampshire, southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Forest is a named woodland and heath area in England, so it is a particular forest.

clue.text: Officers accepted it — it's worth more than diamonds

parts.note: majors are army officers
U stands for upper-class usage, what is socially accepted

explanation.surface: Officers took something that is more valuable than diamonds.
explanation.walkthrough: U meaning socially acceptable is a British convention from the 'U and non-U' debate. In bridge, spades and hearts are the higher-scoring suits, ranking above diamonds and clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, spades and hearts outrank and outscore diamonds and clubs, the two lower suits.

clue.text: Follow us about in various directions

indicators.note: in places the turned word inside the compass points

parts.note: E, N and E are compass points: east, north, east

indicators.note: about says the little word us is turned round

explanation.surface: An invitation to come after us as we wander every which way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the little word round; 'various directions' are the compass points east, north and east, with 'in' putting the turned word between N and the final E.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to come after something as a result, so it means to follow on.

clue.text: Elected representative rates no special treatment

indicators.note: giving the letters special treatment means working them over into a new order

explanation.surface: A politician complains that rates bring no favours from the council.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special treatment' rearranges the seven letters of RATES NO.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a senate is chosen by voters to sit in a legislature on their behalf.

clue.text: Do this to avoid trouble — it could start the fire

definitions.meaning: touching wood is a superstitious act, said aloud too, to ward off bad luck (Americans knock on wood)
a soft rotted wood used as tinder to catch a spark

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the luck-preserving gesture; the other is dry rotten wood used as tinder.

clue.text: Bear around American city is fair game

indicators.note: around tells us the bear's name is turned the other way

parts.note: Pooh is the bear in A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh stories
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A bear prowling round a US city is a legitimate target.
explanation.walkthrough: Pooh is the bear from A. A. Milne's stories, and 'around' turns his name. 'Fair game' means a game at a fairground, where rings are thrown over prizes, not the idiom for a legitimate target.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoopla is a sideshow at a fairground in which players toss rings over prizes.

clue.text: Loafer reformed by being introduced to the foreign parts of the sphere

parts.note: la is 'the' in French

indicators.note: being introduced to says one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: zones are belts of the globe, such as the tropical or temperate zones

indicators.note: reformed says the little word by is rearranged

explanation.surface: An idle person who changed after encountering distant lands of the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reformed' rearranges BY to YB, and 'being introduced to' sets it inside the zones of the globe. LA is 'the' in French, so 'the foreign' gives it.
explanation.definitionFit: A loafer is an idle person, and lazybones is an informal word for one.

clue.text: I was inclined to accept new fiance

indicators.note: to accept means taking another letter inside

parts.note: tended means was inclined

explanation.surface: A man admits he was inclined to accept his new fiancée.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to accept' places N between I and TENDED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's intended is the person they plan to marry, their betrothed.

clue.text: Put on when birds are about

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: are about says the birds are turned around

parts.note: emus are large flightless birds

explanation.surface: Someone dresses up whenever birds come around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are about' turns EMUS into SUME.
explanation.definitionFit: To assume a manner or garment is to take it on, as in putting on airs.

clue.text: To put it another way, trepan

definitions.text: To put it another way, trepan

indicators.note: To put it another way asks for the letters of the next word set out in a different order

explanation.surface: Offering a synonym for an unusual verb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To put it another way' rearranges TREPAN and also offers a synonym: trepan is an archaic verb meaning to ensnare.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepan is an old verb meaning to lure or trick into a trap.

clue.text: Occupant who could be designated by 9Z

indicators.note: could be designated by invites us to rearrange what the spelt-out symbols give

parts.note: the figure and letter read out as nine zed, zed being the British name for Z

explanation.surface: A resident who might be identified by a code like 9Z.
explanation.walkthrough: Say '9Z' as words: NINE ZED, the British name for the letter. 'could be designated by' rearranges those seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A denizen is an inhabitant, someone who lives in or frequents a place.

clue.text: Key man is in it, in a manner of speaking

parts.note: D is a musical key

indicators.note: is in says the man's name sits inside the other word

parts.note: Alec is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man with the key part is in a manner of speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' is a musical key, D, not a key for a lock. 'is in' puts the man's name inside IT, and 'in a' then links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialect is a regional form of a language, a way of talking.

clue.text: Express disapproval in the end

definitions.meaning: an aim or goal, as in 'to that end'

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to protest, the other is a purpose or goal.

clue.text: Woman without a job

indicators.note: without tells us a letter is left out

parts.note: Bertha is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman who is unemployed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without a' removes the final A of BERTHA. 'Job' is the definition, so the woman is only the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A berth is an informal word for a post or position, as in a comfortable berth.

clue.text: Sport needs a little money, we hear — money from abroad

parts.note: RU is rugby union

indicators.note: we hear says the next piece is said out loud

parts.note: p is a penny, a small coin

explanation.surface: A sport requires a small amount of foreign money.
explanation.walkthrough: RU is rugby union. The letter P, short for penny, is spoken as 'pee', which is how the British say pence.
explanation.definitionFit: The rupee is the currency of India, Pakistan and other countries.

clue.text: Vehicle back board is easily handled

indicators.note: back says the vehicle's name is read in the other direction

parts.note: a cart is a vehicle
a table is a board, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: The rear board of a vehicle is simple to manage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns CART into TRAC; 'is' joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tractable is docile and manageable, easy to control or work with.

clue.text: Try showing discrimination

definitions.meaning: to sample food to see what it is like
a fine judgement of what is good, especially in art or dress

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is sampling food; the other is refined judgement in matters of style.

clue.text: Page one is the source of intelligence

indicators.note: the source of is read as the letters being raw material for a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A newspaper's front page is where readers get their information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the source of' rearranges the nine letters of PAGE ONE IS. 'Intelligence' is the spying sense, not cleverness.
explanation.definitionFit: Spying is the gathering of secret intelligence, so this word names that work.

clue.text: Council busy, no doubt? Not altogether

indicators.note: Not altogether says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark that a council is surely busy, followed by doubt about it.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the end of 'busy' and ends inside 'doubt'.
explanation.definitionFit: A synod is an assembly of church leaders, a kind of council.

clue.text: With it, 26 is divided by 22

indicators.note: is divided by says one word is split open with another set in the gap

parts.note: the clue for 26 Down opens 'Try', which gives the word try
22 Down's second definition is 'the end', so it supplies the word end

explanation.surface: A sum where one number is divided by another, said to be fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers point to other clues: 26 Down's clue begins with 'Try', and 22 Down's ends 'the end'. 'is divided by' splits the first word open with the second set in the gap.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with it means being up to date and fashionable, which is what trendy describes.

clue.text: Under pressure, sweets are sent back

indicators.note: sent back says the word is returned, read from the other end

parts.note: desserts are sweets, the puddings at the end of a meal

explanation.surface: A stressed diner whose puddings have been returned to the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' turns DESSERTS round, letter by letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To be stressed is to be suffering strain and tension.
